description: This file contains unit tests for the ActiveSessions class, which manages OpenCDMSessions, including creation, retrieval, and removal, with mock dependencies and test cases verifying session lifecycle and key status handling.

classes.name: ActiveSessionsTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing ActiveSessions, setting up mock dependencies and callbacks.

methods.name: GetShouldReturnNullWhenSessionIsNotPresent
methods.description: Test that retrieving a session by key ID returns null if the session does not exist.

methods.name: ShouldCreateSessionGetShouldFailForUknownKey
methods.description: Test that creating a session and then attempting to retrieve a non-existent key returns null.

methods.name: ShouldCreateSessionGetShouldSucceed
methods.description: Test that creating a session and then retrieving it by key ID returns the correct session object.

methods.name: SessionShouldExistUntilLastInstanceIsRemoved
methods.description: Test that a session remains retrievable until it is explicitly removed, even if multiple references exist.
